description: Implement the complete CustomTkinter multi-page GUI: App shell, sidebar navigation, Dashboard, Predict Sign, Prediction History, Dataset Info, Model Info, Settings, and About pages. Depends on FEAT-001 (all services must exist). This is independent of FEAT-003 (tests).
steps: 1. Create src/ui/app.py — App class extends ctk.CTk. In __init__: call ctk.set_appearance_mode('dark'); ctk.set_default_color_theme('blue'); set title 'Traffic Sign Recognition | AI Dashboard'; geometry '1280x800'; minsize(1024,700); configure(bg_color='#0B1120'). Build layout: left sidebar (200px fixed width, bg=#111827), right content area (fills remaining, bg=#151E2E). Instantiate all 7 page frames (DashboardPage, PredictPage, HistoryPage, DatasetPage, ModelPage, SettingsPage, AboutPage) passing self and services as arguments. Use grid layout: sidebar column 0 fixed, content column 1 weight=1. show_page(name) method: hides current page, shows requested page via .grid(). Sidebar nav buttons call show_page(). Start on DashboardPage.

2. Create src/ui/app.py sidebar section — Inside App, build Sidebar as a CTkFrame (master=self, width=200, fg_color='#111827'). Add: app logo label (traffic light emoji + 'TSR' in accent color, font Segoe UI 14 bold); app subtitle ('AI Dashboard', subtext color). Then nav buttons for: Dashboard (icon ⬛, but use text icons: use Unicode chars — Dashboard '⊞', Predict '◎', History '📋', Dataset '📊', Model '🧠', Settings '⚙', About 'ℹ'). Each nav button is a CTkButton(sidebar, text='⊞  Dashboard', anchor='w', fg_color='transparent', text_color='#94A3B8', hover_color='#1E293B', font=('Segoe UI',13), height=42). Active button gets text_color='#38BDF8', fg_color='#1E293B'. set_active_nav(name) method updates button states. At sidebar bottom: version label 'v1.0.0'.

3. Create src/ui/dashboard_page.py — DashboardPage(CTkFrame). Layout: title row ('Traffic Sign Recognition', subtitle 'AI-Powered Computer Vision Dashboard'). Stats row: 4 stat cards (CTkFrame bg=#1E293B, rounded) showing: Total Predictions (from history), Dataset Size '34,776 images', Classes '43 signs', Model Accuracy '~96% (training)'. Quick action buttons: 'Upload & Predict' (→ PredictPage), 'View History' (→ HistoryPage). Recent predictions panel: last 5 from HistoryService shown as compact rows (timestamp, sign name, confidence badge). Refresh stats on every show via refresh() method called by App.show_page().

4. Create src/ui/predict_page.py — PredictPage(CTkFrame). This is the main functional page. Layout split into left panel (image upload area, 480px) and right panel (results area). LEFT PANEL: Upload zone — a CTkFrame with dashed border look (achieved via custom draw or nested frames), label 'Drop image here or click Upload'. Buttons: 'Upload Image' (CTkButton, accent color), 'Clear' (secondary). File info section: labels for filename, dimensions, file size, format — hidden until image loaded. Image preview: CTkLabel with image= parameter, max 380x300 display. 'Predict Sign' button (disabled until valid image loaded, full-width, accent). RIGHT PANEL: Initially shows placeholder 'No prediction yet — upload an image to begin'. After prediction: Result card (CTkFrame bg=#1E293B) containing: predicted sign name (large, white), class ID badge, confidence percentage with colored indicator (green >=80%, amber 60-79%, red <60%), confidence bar (CTkProgressBar), low-confidence warning if applicable, top-3 predictions as labeled rows with progress bars, timestamp, processing time. Prediction runs in background thread via threading.Thread(target=_run_prediction); result dispatched via app.after(0, _show_result). Use ImageValidator before prediction. Show CTkProgressBar (indeterminate mode) during inference. Error states shown in result panel with red text.

5. In predict_page.py implement drag-and-drop support — use tkinterdnd2 if available (check: try: import tkinterdnd2; HAVE_DND=True except ImportError: HAVE_DND=False). If not available, silently skip drag-and-drop and show only the Upload button. Do NOT make tkinterdnd2 a hard dependency. The Upload button is always present and always works.

6. Create src/ui/history_page.py — HistoryPage(CTkFrame). Layout: header with 'Prediction History' title + 'Export CSV' button + 'Clear History' button (with confirmation dialog). Filter/search bar: CTkEntry for text search by sign name. History list: CTkScrollableFrame containing rows. Each row is a compact CTkFrame showing: index, thumbnail (32x32 if available), sign name, class ID, confidence (colored badge), timestamp. Selecting a row shows detail panel on right: full prediction details. refresh() method reloads from HistoryService. Handles empty state with friendly message. Confirmation dialog for clear uses CTkInputDialog or messagebox.

7. Create src/ui/dataset_page.py — DatasetPage(CTkFrame). Shows dataset statistics WITHOUT loading all images (uses pre-computed values from config). Content: header 'Dataset Information'. Stats cards: Total Images '34,776', Classes '43', Dataset 'GTSRB (German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark)', Split info. Class distribution chart: matplotlib bar chart embedded via FigureCanvasTkAgg(fig, master=ctk_frame_instance). Chart shows all 43 class image counts. Chart bg matches dashboard (#151E2E), bar color=#38BDF8. Class browser: CTkScrollableFrame listing all 43 signs from signs.classes with class ID and name. Dataset path info. Note: chart data uses hardcoded counts from a DATASET_CLASS_COUNTS dict in config.py pre-populated with the actual counts (0:157, 1:1980, 2:2010, etc.) so no filesystem scan at runtime.

8. Create src/ui/model_page.py — ModelPage(CTkFrame). Shows model architecture info from ModelService.get_model_info(). Content: header 'Model Information'. Info cards: input shape, output shape, total parameters, file size, num layers, training framework. Architecture table: scrollable list of layers with name, type, output shape, parameters — extracted from model.layers during load and stored in model_info dict. Training info section: dataset used, epochs, optimizer, loss function, preprocessing pipeline description. Performance note: states these are training metrics, not guaranteed real-world accuracy.

9. Create src/ui/settings_page.py — SettingsPage(CTkFrame). Settings stored in a JSON file at database/settings.json via a simple load/save pattern. Settings controls: Confidence Threshold slider (CTkSlider, 0.0–1.0, default 0.60, with label showing current value). Appearance Mode toggle (CTkOptionMenu: Dark/Light/System — calls ctk.set_appearance_mode). Font size selector (CTkOptionMenu: Small/Normal/Large). Max History size entry (CTkEntry, validates integer). Show confidence warning toggle (CTkSwitch). 'Save Settings' button (CTkButton accent): saves to database/settings.json and applies live. 'Reset Defaults' button. Settings are read by PredictionService for CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD.

10. Create src/ui/about_page.py — AboutPage(CTkFrame). Content: app logo and title (large). Version, description. Technology stack section: cards for Python 3.11, TensorFlow 2.15.1, Keras 2.15.0, CustomTkinter 5.2.2, NumPy 1.26.4, Pillow 10.4.0. Dataset info: GTSRB citation. Model info summary. Contributors section from README.md. GitHub link label. License info. Disclaimer: 'This application is for educational purposes. Do not use for real-world traffic safety decisions without proper validation.'

11. Create src/ui/__init__.py — empty. Wire all imports. In App.__init__ after creating pages, call self.show_page('dashboard') to set initial state. Ensure every page implements a refresh() method (even if empty) so App.show_page() can call page.refresh() without AttributeError.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'python run.py' launches the application window with dark theme, sidebar, and DashboardPage visible — no exceptions on startup.
Sidebar nav buttons switch between all 7 pages without errors.
PredictPage: uploading a JPG/PNG via the Upload button shows image preview and enables Predict button.
PredictPage: clicking Predict runs inference and displays predicted sign name, class ID, confidence percentage, and top-3 results.
Prediction runs in background thread — UI does not freeze during inference.
HistoryPage: after a prediction, history list shows the prediction record.
DatasetPage: matplotlib chart renders inside the CTk window without error.
ModelPage: shows correct input shape (None,32,32,1), output shape (None,43), and total params (281153).
SettingsPage: confidence threshold slider saves and reloads correctly.
Error handling: uploading a non-image file shows an error message; clicking Predict without an image is disabled.

Import check passes (All UI imports OK). app.py: App(ctk.CTk) with sidebar nav + grid-based page switching. dashboard_page.py: stat cards, quick actions, recent predictions list. predict_page.py: upload zone, image preview, background-thread inference, result card with top-3 bars and confidence indicator. history_page.py: searchable scrollable list with detail panel, CSV export, clear with confirmation. dataset_page.py: stats cards, matplotlib FigureCanvasTkAgg bar chart (drawn once on first visit), class browser. model_page.py: info cards, layer table from model.layers, training details, performance disclaimer. settings_page.py: confidence slider, appearance mode, font size, max history, show/save/reset. about_page.py: hero, tech stack cards, dataset info, disclaimer. All pages implement refresh().
